# AstryxList { #anylumino.AstryxList }

```python
AstryxList(items, *, header='', **props)
```

Render an Astryx list from item records.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Default    |
|---------|-----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| items   | Iterable\[Any\] | Item records used by generated child components or static search sources.                                                                                                                                                                         | _required_ |
| header  | str             | Optional header text or content.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `''`       |
| **props | Any             | JSON-safe List props. Useful keys: density, hasDividers, listStyle, start, className, and style. anylumino generates child items from items and passes header separately. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/List>. | `{}`       |
